temp_voices.additional:
**What are temporary voice channels?**
Temporary voice channels are channels created by users when they join a lobby channel. The owner of a temporary voice channel can configure their own channel.

**How to set up temporary voice channels?**
1. Create/pick a lobby channel
2. Set the lobby channel using /voice setup
